content: Lubrication degradation fault on pump P-302 SKF6308 bearing at ISO Stage 2. Elevated temperature reading 68 deg C, vibration 3.4 mm/s RMS. Kurtosis 3.2 with broadband noise floor increase consistent with dry-running friction. No discrete fault frequencies observed. Root cause: lubricant starvation due to blocked grease relief port and extended interval since last lubrication service. Bearing operating in corrosive environment with high ambient humidity causing grease oxidation. Action taken: immediate lubrication with Mobilux EP2, cleared relief port blockage, flushed contaminated grease. Asset monitored for 4 hours post-lubrication. Temperature reduced to 42 deg C, vibration settled to 1.6 mm/s RMS within 3 hours confirming Stage 2 recovery. No bearing replacement required at this stage. Lesson: pump bearings in humid or corrosive environments require 4-week lubrication intervals rather than standard 6-week cycle. Grease relief port inspection must be included in every PM visit. Delayed action at Stage 2 lubrication faults often progresses to Stage 3 inner race spalling within 30 days.
